notes:
{積立|つみたて} refers to regular savings or accumulation, commonly used in financial contexts.

WRITING:
- ⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (to pile up, accumulate)
- ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to set up, establish)

USAGE:
- {積立|つみたて}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to save regularly - suru verb)
- ⟦{積|つ}み{立|た}てる→積み立てる：21136_tsumitateru⟧ (verb form - to accumulate)

COMPOUNDS:
- {積立|つみたて}⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧ (installment savings)
- {積立|つみたて}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (accumulation-type insurance)

FINANCIAL CONTEXT:
- Popular savings method in Japan
- Often automatic monthly deductions
- Used for retirement, education, travel funds

{積立|つみたて}NISA:
- Tax-advantaged investment account in Japan
- Encourages long-term, regular investing
- Popular since 2018
